description: AM35 DPI stage selector (set_dpi_c) uses RACE raceId 0x30C7. Param stage encoded as u8 at offset 6 (1-based stage index, 1..8). RACE framing: [0x05, 0x5A, length_le_u16, raceId_le_u16, ...params]. No request checksum. Source: disassembly/AM35model.dis set_dpi_c. Getter 0x30C5 returns DPI state including currentStage at res[10] (parsers.json am35-dpi).

readback.comment: response includes stageCount@9=5, currentStage@10=3, dpiX array@11 (8x le-u16), dpiY array@27 (8x le-u16)
